verdict.rationale: Google ships an official Antigravity CLI with its own product page and a docs section covering headless/non-interactive scripting with machine-readable output for CI, sandboxing, Vim mode, slash-command configuration, and migration from Gemini CLI. A community user also reports using Antigravity CLI and says it works fine. Missing for 10: installation and full command-reference details, and hands-on corroboration deeper than a single brief community comment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
Access plugins, MCP, skills, and hooks configurations instantly via slash commands, quickly enhancing your workflow.
Now, I'll do the same with Antigravity CLI and vscode. It works fine.
